text:
maria_cs: Sharing a one-page customer-facing checklist for new tenants — focused on caching / batching / streaming best-practices + quick ops triggers for renewal risk. Want quick eyes before I send to ACME. TL;DR: two onboarding knobs (client initialSeed size, stream mode), telemetry hooks, and a 'what to do if errors spike' section. Draft on Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/cs/engage-lite

aj_devx: Nice — can we add a tiny client SDK example? e.g., set `batchMaxTokens` and `stream: false` for small trials. Also add a short note about preserving prompt consistency for eval comparisons. :+1:

maria_cs: Yep added. Draft snippet below — can you sanity check?
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ batchMaxTokens: 64, stream: false, initialSeed: true });
await client.generate({ model: 'open-6b', prompt: '...' });
```
aj_devx: Looks good. Suggest `initialSeed: false` when the customer already has server-side prefix caching to avoid duplicate seeding. Also add a troubleshooting mini-flow: 'latency up -> decrease batchMaxTokens or enable streaming; cost high -> enable KV cache & switch to quantized model variant.'
sam_se: @maria_cs where do we capture renewal-risk signals? Can we list 3 telemetry flags to watch and who to ping: 1) low usage after day 7 (DAU drop > 60%), 2) repeated timeouts in 48h (>3 per tenant), 3) sudden drop in quality score vs baseline (>10% delta). Also add a small contact matrix (AE / CSM / Eng ops) for escalation.
guillermo_sre: Streaming ops note: recommend short stream heartbeats (2s) and a 10s connection keepalive. Server-side: if stream mode is active, don't wait for full batch window before flushing partial results. Circuit-breaker thresholds idea: 5% error rate sustained over 5m -> auto-page CS; 15% over 1m -> failover to smaller model variant.
maria_cs: Thanks — added the three signals and the contact matrix. I also dropped in a one-click end-user feedback form so product teams can capture qualitative issues: https://forms.redwood/customer-feedback?tmpl=engage-lite

opsbot: deploy-bot: cs/engage-lite published to /public/cs-engage/engage-lite-v1.pdf — checksum abc123

aj_devx: :thumbsup: left a tiny wording nit in Confluence. Once that's fixed we can email the guide + a 15-min sync invite to ACME.
maria_cs: Cool — I'll send by EOD. Thanks everyone. Marking thread closed unless there are last comments.
